claim: When SNS delivers to a subscribed SQS queue, the SQS message holds the subject and message that were published plus metadata about the message, in a JSON document. If raw message delivery is enabled for the SQS endpoint, any SNS metadata is stripped and the message is sent as is.

values.display: subject and message that were published
metadata about the message in a JSON document
any Amazon SNS metadata is stripped

qualifiers.condition: the JSON document applies when raw message delivery is not enabled; with raw message delivery the message is sent as is

evidence.quote: The Amazon SQS message contains the subject and message that were published to the topic along with metadata about the message in a JSON document.
When you enable raw message delivery for or Amazon SQS endpoints, any Amazon SNS metadata is stripped from the published message and the message is sent as is.
